name: Doom Melt
description: The first clip melts down in uneven columns, like the Doom screen wipe. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: amplitude
params.description: Speed difference between columns (0: all fall together)

params.name: noise
params.description: Random part of the speed differences

params.name: frequency
params.description: Speed variation across the frame (higher: shorter waves)

params.name: drip_scale
params.description: How much the middle columns run first
